title: Russian-provoked incident causing casualties on NATO territory could be red line for Alliance – Rinkēvičs
summary: An incident provoked by Russia that results in casualties on the territory of a NATO member state could constitute a red line for the Alliance.

title: SBU detains hairdresser in Sloviansk suspected of directing Russian strikes
summary: The Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) has detained a woman suspected of directing Russian strikes on Sloviansk.

title: War update: 151 clashes along the front line; 40 Russian troops killed on Pokrovsk axis
summary: On November 25, Ukrainian forces reported 151 combat engagements along the front line, including 18 Russian attacks repelled in the Pokrovsk sector.
